scenario_sources.S2: r_fleet — EU domestic-transport pathway, 795.6 MtCO2e in 2023 to 583 MtCO2e in 2030 (0.0434/yr). Regional sector proxy: it covers all domestic transport, not passenger cars alone, and is applied to every member state. r_power — EU public electricity and heat production held to the binding economy-wide 2030 target of -55% against 1990 (0.0000/yr). Pro-rata, and applied to grid intensity under constant generation, which understates decarbonisation if demand grows: the resulting BEV benefit is conservative.
scenario_sources.S3: r_fleet — EU domestic transport held to the recommended economy-wide 2040 target of -90% against 1990 (0.1351/yr). Pro-rata: no transport sub-target exists. r_power — The same pro-rata construction against the recommended 2040 target of -90% (0.0856/yr).

scenario_sources.S1: r_fleet — Observed national trend in CO2 per registered car, log-linear over 2015-2024 excluding 2020-2021. It is an outturn, not a policy commitment. r_power — Observed national trend in electricity carbon intensity, log-linear over 2015-2024 excluding 2020-2021. Independently sourced from the fleet trend, so r_fleet != r_power by construction.
scenario_sources.S2: r_fleet — EU domestic-transport pathway, 795.6 MtCO2e in 2023 to 583 MtCO2e in 2030 (0.0434/yr). Regional sector proxy: it covers all domestic transport, not passenger cars alone, and is applied to every member state. r_power — EU public electricity and heat production held to the binding economy-wide 2030 target of -55% against 1990 (0.0000/yr). Pro-rata, and applied to grid intensity under constant generation, which understates decarbonisation if demand grows: the resulting BEV benefit is conservative.
scenario_sources.S3: r_fleet — EU domestic transport held to the recommended economy-wide 2040 target of -90% against 1990 (0.1351/yr). Pro-rata: no transport sub-target exists. r_power — The same pro-rata construction against the recommended 2040 target of -90% (0.0856/yr).

warnings: PATHWAY_ALREADY_MET: EU public electricity and heat CO2 in 2024 (513 MtCO2) is already below the pro-rata 2030 level (552 MtCO2). The implied rate is -0.0121/yr; S2 grid intensity is held flat at the observed level instead of being allowed to rise.

VKT_PROXY: no national car traffic series is published, so the EU average distance per car is used. The benchmark side is unaffected (distance cancels in CO2 per car); the product side scales directly with this proxy.

FLEET_INTENSITY_IMPLAUSIBLE: 391 gCO2/km is outside 80-320. The national car CO2 inventory and the registered stock cover different driving populations (cross-border refuelling), so this benchmark is tiered down to C.
TIER_C_SUPPRESSION: Tier-C/unknown affected-unit share 58% exceeds threshold 50%; emit directional label only.

portfolio_withheld.reason: Rolling portfolio TI needs multi-year cohorts. Only the 2024 cohort is observed, and repeating it would publish a counterfactual as a result.
portfolio_withheld.unblocked_by: registration cohorts for at least T consecutive years

vkt_proxy.note: Low and high are the lower and upper quartile of the distances actually measured across the member states that publish one. A longer assumed distance raises the product's emissions while the benchmark, which is CO2 per car, does not move.
